name: Dynamis Robotic Surgical System
description: Navigation-based robotic system for spine and hard tissue surgery. Features three robotic arms: two for surgical guidance and one for optical navigation, all mounted on a single cart. Supports multiple surgical instruments through adjustable end-effectors. Received FDA 510(k) clearance in April 2025. First U.S. clinical use was at Southern Hills Hospital in Las Vegas in October 2025.
